summary: Split the overloaded escalatedTo relationship into three distinct relationships
reason: The ontology used one relationship name for three different target role classes, but the transcript treats escalation to IT Service Owner, Application Owner, and Technical Owner as separately tracked relationships.
agentImpact: The agent can now distinguish which owner role an incident was escalated to without ambiguous predicate overloading.
before: Three relationships all named escalatedTo from Incident to ITServiceOwner, ApplicationOwner, and TechnicalOwner.
after: Three separately named relationships: escalatedToServiceOwner, escalatedToApplicationOwner, and escalatedToTechnicalOwner.
evidence: "Escalation relationships to the IT Service Owner, Application Owner, and Technical Owner should all be captured as relationships."
